verdict.rationale: Termius docs describe broadcasting commands to all open sessions simultaneously, running snippets across multiple hosts at once, and group-level settings (like jump hosts) that automatically apply to every host in the group, directly supporting bulk operations across many items. However, there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of these bulk features at scale, and no evidence of bulk editing/deleting of hosts or other bulk management operations beyond command execution. Missing for 10: independent verification of broadcast/snippet bulk execution, evidence of bulk item management (e.g., mass edit/delete of hosts or groups).
